hero.name: Nguyen Manh Tu
hero.summary: Backend Software Engineer with 2+ years in Java/Spring Boot and AWS, now specializing in AI Engineering — building RAG systems, semantic search and real-time AI platforms with FastAPI, Qdrant and OpenAI.

fpt.stack: Java · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL · AWS · Docker · GraphQL · Testing
bullets: Backend Development: Built backend APIs for HR systems using Java, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL — improving system efficiency by 20%.
Cloud Infrastructure: Implemented batch jobs and asynchronous processing with AWS SQS; used Docker and LocalStack to optimize local development and testing.
Leadership: Led a 4–5 member backend sub-team, coordinating tasks and running code reviews — boosting team productivity by 30% during the lead's absence.

course.name: Practical AI Talent Program — Foundation
course.stack: AI Thinking · AI Ethics · SFIA · AI Assistants · Problem-Solving
bullets: Intensive 12-week, hands-on AI program run by Vingroup and delivered with VinUniversity, built on the SFIA global skills framework.
Trained in AI thinking, AI ethics, practical AI skills and solving real problems with AI assistants under VinUni faculty.
Certificate co-issued by VinUniversity and Vingroup on graduation.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Products I've built — from AI platforms to enterprise backend systems.

vcareer.title: VCareer
vcareer.subtitle: AI Career Development Platform
vcareer.description: End-to-end AI career platform: real-time AI interviews (WebRTC · LiveKit · OpenAI Realtime · Gemini Live), a Three.js 3D TalkingHead avatar, CV improvement, CV/JD matching and application tracking. Built on a Next.js 16 full-stack architecture with Server Components, Server Actions, Zod and Drizzle ORM over Neon PostgreSQL. 1st Runner-up at Codex Hackathon 2026.

scholarai.title: ScholarAI
scholarai.subtitle: AI-Augmented Research Workspace
scholarai.description: AI-powered engine to discover and read academic papers: hybrid semantic search (dense + BM25), hierarchical chunking, citation-aware chat-with-paper (streaming RAG), and hallucination guardrails (cosine thresholds, scope-enforcing prompts). RAG quality measured with LangSmith (hit rate, citation accuracy, faithfulness).

finplanning.title: Financial Planning System
finplanning.subtitle: Expense management & tracking system
finplanning.description: Expense management system helping enterprises make financial data and internal processes transparent. Java Spring Boot backend with RESTful APIs for expense management and reporting, a React + Tailwind frontend, and Redis for caching and query performance.
